msg91-m91-skill-root.description: How software or AI reaches a human when it needs one and gets the answer back. Use it wherever a program needs a person to decide, approve, answer, verify, take over, act physically or simply know, and also for alerting, on-call, paging, escalation and failure handling. Use it too for "tell me when X", for human approval inside an agent run, for showing and answering those alerts inside a product's own desktop, web or mobile app, and when deciding whether email, SMS or Slack is enough for something that cannot wait.
